items.headline: Gale Warning issued October 16 at 5:22AM CDT until October 17 at 7:00AM CDT by NWS Corpus Christi TX
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 25 to 30 knots with gusts up to 40 knots and
very rough waters expected.

* WHERE...Baffin Bay and Upper Laguna Madre, Corpus Christi and
Nueces Bays, Copano, Aransas, and Redfish Bays and San
Antonio, Mesquite, and Espiritu Santo Bays.

* WHEN...Until 7 AM CDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Gale force winds and high seas will result in
dangerous marine conditions which could result in capsized or
damaged vessels.
items.instruction:
Mariners should consider altering plans to avoid possible
hazardous conditions.  Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter
course, and/or secure the vessel for severe wind and seas.

items.headline: Gale Warning issued October 16 at 5:22AM CDT until October 17 at 1:00PM CDT by NWS Corpus Christi TX
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 25 to 30 knots with gusts up to 45 knots and
seas 8 to 13 feet expected.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Baffin Bay to Port Aransas out 20
NM, Coastal waters from Port Aransas to Matagorda Ship Channel
out 20 NM, Waters from Baffin Bay to Port Aransas from 20 to
60 NM and Waters from Port Aransas to Matagorda Ship Channel
from 20 to 60 NM.

* WHEN...Until 1 PM CDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Gale force winds and high seas will result in
dangerous marine conditions which could result in capsized or
damaged vessels.
items.instruction:
Mariners should consider altering plans to avoid possible
hazardous conditions.  Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter
course, and/or secure the vessel for severe wind and seas.
